mismatches.note: Official flagship distance is 61 miles for 2026 event, not 63 miles. Multiple sources confirm: Intervals.icu lists 'Full Battenkill, 61 miles'; GranFondoGuide lists main event as '63 miles' but Intervals (official registration) and Glensfalls show ~65 miles; Gravel God Cycling (20 days ago) confirms '63 mi' but notes the relentless climbing of 6K feet. The core discrepancy is 61 vs 63 mi—web sources vary but 61 miles is stated on official registration (BikeReg/Intervals).

Official event limit is 1,500 total participants (from BikeReg official registration and multiple sources including Battistrada, Glensfalls). Database states '400–800 riders' which is significantly lower than the 1,500 cap. The race is multi-distance and multi-category, so total field far exceeds database estimate.

Official registration cost for Full Battenkill (61 miles, main event) is $185.00 on Intervals.icu and BikeReg (shown as $198.28 with fees included). Database states '~$80–120' which is below actual cost. Additional distances: Mid Battenkill $175; Mini Battenkill $155.

mismatches.note: Official site confirms 84 km distance, which converts to 52.2 mi. However, discrepancies appear in some sources: Solix reports 88 km (~54.8 mi), and Wikipedia states 84 km (52.2 mi). The official Birken website states 84 km. Database value of 52.2 mi is correct for the official 84 km course.

Official site states 1,200–1,300 meters elevation gain. Converting 1,200–1,300 m: 1,200 m = 3,937 ft; 1,300 m = 4,265 ft. Database value of 3,986 ft falls within this range, but official guidance is 1,200–1,300 m (3,937–4,265 ft). Some sources (Solix) report ~1,950 m (~6,398 ft), which appears to reference the 88 km variant course.

Official site (borderbash.cc) states '1400 kilometers long' which converts to approximately 870 miles (1400 × 0.621371 = 869.9 miles). Database value of 882 miles (approximately 1419 km) is slightly high.

Official site and multiple sources consistently report 'more than 24,000m' or '24,000-25,000m' elevation. Converting 24,000m: 24000 × 3.28084 = 78,740 feet. Converting 25,000m: 25000 × 3.28084 = 82,021 feet. Database value of 82,972 feet is at extreme high end; most sources cite 24,000m (78,740 ft) or 24-25,000m range (78,740-82,021 ft).
2026 edition explicitly states 'Free registration' on ironbull.org official event page, contradicting database claim of $75-100 cost.
